title: THE OPPORTUNITIES AND RISKS OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS IN MENTAL HEALTH

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative risk assessment evaluating and grading the risk levels (Lower, Medium, Higher) of LLMs perpetuating mental health stigma across education, assessment, and intervention use cases.
Conceptual analysis and literature review assessing the risk of disparate model performance stemming from the overrepresentation of White populations in existing mental health training data.

Conceptual analysis and literature review highlighting the risk of biased content generation due to the overrepresentation of highly educated and high-socioeconomic-status perspectives in mental health literature.
Conceptual analysis discussing the limitations and disparities in model performance resulting from training data predominantly composed of English-language discourse.
